problem: The two alternatives in the applicable-plan choice are identical and both require nltl:noxiousLiquidSubstanceEmergencyPlanPolarCoverage=true, so a marine pollution emergency plan cannot satisfy the required NLS-or-marine-pollution-plan alternative.
required_change: Replace the duplicated second alternative with the locked canonical coverage property for the shipboard marine pollution emergency plan, preserving the existing NLS alternative and requiring either one when shipOperatesInPolarWaters=true.
regression_guard: Preserve absent or exclusively false applicability as non-triggering, enforce all common coverage requirements when applicability is true, and accept either the NLS plan or the marine pollution emergency plan.
